items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: When Lois left the boat, him and Sidney Desby made up a band.

ctx.x: And Lois Humphrey. And Lois Humphrey. And Lois Humphrey, I think, was the trumpet player of the wild too.

He was the trumpet player of the wild too. Yeah. See, uh, Lois, when Lois come off of the boat, well, he took, uh, Lois Humphrey his place. Yeah. Lois Humphrey was there before Lois. When Lois left the boat, him and Sidney Desby made up a band. But it didn't last long. Sidney Desby left trumpet and went to playing trombone. Oh, yeah. But that band didn't last no more than about a year. Not quite a year. Yeah.
Tio himself, uh, had about two styles, didn't he, that he used? Two distinct styles of Tio. Tio?
